items.label: Elegant Geometric Design
items.value: Crafted with a black metal frame and rustic brown board, this bookcase, with its half-moon silhouette design, brings sophisticated flair to your favorite aesthetic. Fill the bookshelf with books, photos, plants, and decorations to make it an eye-catching addition to your home

items.label: Solid Construction
items.value: The etagere bookcase is constructed of a durable rustic laminate top with a scratch and stain-resistant finish, which allows for easy cleaning. Its base is crafted from powder-coated iron, giving it a striking geometric silhouette suited for any fashionable room, while the rustic top offers a mixed industrial look

items.label: Ample Storage Space
items.value: Featuring 9 open shelves, this tall bookshelf provides plenty of space for you to display decorative accents, potted plants, and lamps in your bedroom, living room, or home office, while keeping them dust-free. Maximize the vertical wall space and store your small items on the shelves to avoid mess and help keep your room tidy and organized

items.label: Multi-Purpose Use
items.value: Combining wood grain and metal, this open storage shelf adds an industrial style to your home. It can be used as a bookshelf to store a printer and books for your home office, or as a bookcase or room divider to display plants, decor, photos, and bouquets in your living room or bedroom

items.label: Assembly Required
items.value: The Etagere Bookcase needs to be assembled by two people. The package includes a screw bag and instructions. It has clear assembly instructions and marked parts for quick assembly. Enjoy lifetime professional customer service and a worry-free experience. We also provide free exchanges for damaged and missing parts
